decisions.reason: The INA219 placement changes current measurement topology but does not change DCDC1 voltage, rating, regulation, or normal-operation load role.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the board power chain and the main board's local-use and forwarding roles; INA219 measurement details do not require another interface-state change.
The source concerns INA219 placement on the 3.3V rail and does not change the 5V boost converter, enable control, rating, or powered loads.
Placing the INA219 after the Schottky diodes does not alter the USB auxiliary regulator, its activation condition, source-selection policy, or standalone powered-rail coverage.
The source does not change the AXP2101 as the normal power source, the battery voltage range, or its system-load coverage.
The current-monitor placement and coverage do not affect the battery-charge display, external charge LED connector, or resistor population requirements.
The source does not change the battery NTC connector, thermal-protection function, or controller.
The INA219's 3.3V-rail position does not alter battery overcharge, overdischarge, short-circuit, or DW01A protection semantics.
The source contains no decision about the battery connector family, part, pin count, functions, or unresolved pin order.
The source does not change the LEDs' 5V supply, data-level shifting, GPIO, or standby power-control behavior.
The main-board power and current-monitor topology does not change the panel connector inventory, control signals, or button-placement policy.
The INA219 placement does not change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, cable length, bus speed, or signal topology.
